name: Chester
source:
He is afflicted by Enigma, with only a few weeks left to live. Yet he continues on with a laid-back attitude, as though he has no regrets, or perhaps it is just his character.

He washes up on the beach of Carlyle, and is nursed back to consciousness by the local inhabitants. As he spends his time on the island, growing closer to everyone, he start uncovering one of its other faces. How will Chester use his remaining time in this world?

[From [url=http://fruitbatfactory.com/enigma/]Fruitbat Factory[/url]]
